run_gen_tutorials: run the script to generate HTML, JS, ipynb, and py tutorial files from Jupyter notebooks
build_tutorial_html: build HTML tutorial files from Jupyter notebooks using nbconvert HTMLExporter and BeautifulSoup
convert_notebook_to_python: convert a Jupyter notebook to a Python script using nbconvert ScriptExporter
generate_tutorial_js: generate a React TutorialPage JS file for a given tutorial ID using the TEMPLATE string
parse_notebook_metadata: parse a Jupyter notebook with nbformat and set the kernelspec display_name to python3
